items.item_text: Experience working in a service-oriented unit.

Under general supervision, as a member of the sample receiving/prep group, enter client data and prepare samples for parentage verification, coat color and disease diagnostic testing. Entry level position responsible for all aspects of sample documentation, DNA isolation, and curation. Major functions are: 1) DNA extraction from multiple sources including but not limited to: hair roots, buccal swabs, tissue, semen, and blood, 2) distribution of samples to appropriate testing pipelines via accurate distribution of extracted templates coupled with appropriate digital documentation, and 3) enter/confirm client information in the VGL sample database, retrieve stored DNA/hair samples, and archive frozen DNA, plasma and serum samples in storage freezers. Perform reagent preparation and validation, assisting with cleaning, and maintenance of tools and equipment including DNA extraction robots.
Ability to accurately organize, rearrange, and transfer many small items such as samples while maintaining order
Knowledge/skill of DNA extractions techniques from multiple sources including hair, buccal swabs, tissues, and plasma/serum.
Skill to be meticulous and detail oriented and to maintain focus on the work at hand in a busy work environment.
Skill to effectively prioritize tasks on a daily basis while adjusting to fluctuating sample numbers and the needs of other staff members.
Ability to learn detailed, complicated procedures quickly and to follow detailed instructions or protocols with minimal supervision.
Skills to manipulate equipment and computer terminals.
Skill with basic lab tools and techniques (centrifuge, micropipettes, scales).
Skill to proofread work for accuracy and completeness.
